@@U04567@@
How well I know that demons are hard to be rid of, that the spirit bond cannot to be broken! And yet, oh, 忧愁, I will not acknowledge your power, your insidious power!

@@U04569@@
Then feel it now in my parting curse! Mankind is blind from birth; you, 浮士德, are blind now at your last!

@@U04570@@
(She breathes on him. Exit.)

@@U04572@@
(Blinded.)

@@U04573@@
Night closes in now, deeper, darker, yet in my heart’s core a light shines clearly. I must hurry, must complete what I have planned! Only the Master’s word has any weight here. Up! Up from your beds! Servants, workers! Every man! Give final form now to my boldest thoughts! Take up your shovels, your spades, your picks! What is only planned must now be realized! The work staked out must be completed with speed. Strict order and swift diligence will bear the fairest rewards. To realize so vast a design one mind is worth a thousand hands.

@@U04575@@
Torches. 梅菲斯特 as overseer leading a gang of LEMURS.

@@U04577@@
Hurry! This way! This way! Come on!
translation:
@@U04567@@
深知魔难除，神结不可断！然而忧愁啊，我不会承认你的力量，你阴险的力量！

@@U04569@@
那么现在就在我的离别咒语中感受一下吧！人类生来就是盲目的；浮士德你终于瞎了！

@@U04570@@
（她向他呼吸。退出。）

@@U04572@@
（瞎了眼。）

@@U04573@@
夜幕降临了，越来越深，越来越黑，但我的内心深处却有一道光清晰地闪烁着。我一定要抓紧时间，一定要完成我计划好的事情！在这里，只有师父的话才有分量。向上！从床上起来！仆人、工人！每个男人！现在就将我最大胆的想法付诸实践吧！拿起你的铲子，你的铁锹，你的镐！刚刚计划好的事情现在必须实现！放样的工作必须尽快完成。严格的秩序和迅速的勤勉将会得到最公平的回报。要实现如此庞大的设计，一颗心抵得上一千只手。

@@U04575@@
火把。 梅菲斯特作为监督者领导着一群狐猴。

@@U04577@@
快点！这边走！这边走！快点！
